name: Why does + New create a conversation while nvk child creates a ghost?

why-does-new-create-a-conversation-while.label: Why does + New create a conversation while nvk child creates a ghost?
Current-state evidence: Novakai Command revision d1faccbe, inspected 2026-08-28. Every architecture object is one source or persistent-state file; folder zones mirror the directory tree.
Legend
lines: blue = app command path · green = authoritative creation/persistence
rose = observed ghost-state path or failed ownership lookup
violet/amber = existing integrated child seam that the CLI does not call
thick wire = material state write · dashed wire = missing connection

why-does-new-create-a-conversation-while.label: Finding
lines: + New creates the canonical Agent, Person binding, ConversationView, and SendJournal before provider effects.
nvk child writes the child Agent to .novakai/agents.jsonl, then launches Claude directly.
The Claude identity hook is valid, but ingestion cannot resolve that Agent in .novakai/stores/agents.jsonl.
Ownership must exist in the app's canonical Agent directory before transcript ingestion can attach the provider session.
